changes_made.explanation: Consolidated task variations into a single normalized form. All refer to the same NLG task of generating sub-event sequences for processes.
Simplified E-ROUGE variants to base form according to normalization rules. E-ROUGE1 and E-ROUGE2 are variants of the same E-ROUGE metric.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation was conducted. The paper only uses automatic metrics and baseline comparisons.

guideline: We evaluate how much percentage of the sub-event and time-ordered sub-event pairs in the induced sequence is covered by the human-provided references

changes_made.explanation: Changed answer from 'No' to 'No' (no change in answer, but corrected metadata). The paper uses human-generated references but does NOT conduct human evaluation of generated outputs. The human-generated sequences are only used as gold standards for automatic evaluation.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on sub-event sequence generation as an NLG task. It uses E-ROUGE as the main automatic evaluation metric but does not conduct human evaluations or use LLMs as judges. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization of metric variants and clarification about the role of human-generated sequences (references vs. evaluations).
